
The following figures shows the uniform hazard spectra for spectral ordinates with 5% damping in rock (BC) for different confidence levels.

```{r echo=FALSE}
Vs30_TARGET <- 760
TR_TARGET <- c(200,500,1000,2000,2500,5000,10000)
YMAX <- 1.0

```


::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}


```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Uniform Hazard Spectra Sa[g] in rock, with 5% damping - Mean Values"
#| label: fig-UHS_AEP_docx
#| column: page-inset-right
#| 
p_TARGET <- "mean"
DATA <- UHSTable[TR %in% TR_TARGET & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p %in% p_TARGET,.(ID=TR,Y=Sa,X=Tn)]|> unique()
setorder(DATA,X)
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "hc",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.max =YMAX,
  xAxis.legend="Tn[s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa[g]",
  group.legend="TR[yr]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```

:::


::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills .content-visible when-format="html" unless-format="revealjs"}


### p=mean
```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Uniform Hazard Spectra Sa[g] in rock, with 5% damping, for 1/100 to 1/10,000 years AEP"
#| label: fig-UHS_AEP
p_TARGET <- "mean"
DATA <- UHSTable[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p %in% p_TARGET,.(ID=TR,Y=Sa,X=Tn)]|> unique()
setorder(DATA,X)
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "hc",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=FALSE,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.max = YMAX,
  xAxis.legend="Tn[s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa[g]",
  group.legend="TR[yr]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```
